text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing. I heard 
some commotion coming from an arcade, so 
when I peeked inside—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, geez, what is this!? I seriously can't 
even deal with this~~~!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, Jordan-chan. What's the matter, 
raising your voice like that?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san! Ugh, look at this! It's totally 
unreal!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: A "punching machine"...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"If you get a high score on 'Umamusume' 
difficulty, you can win a prize, but—"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard I punch it, I can't get 
a high score!! Is it broken?! Or is this a 
total scam?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, seriously the worst! I really wanted 
that nail kit prize, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, is that so. That must be 
frustrating. Mm-hmm—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Jordan-chan. I'll be watching, so 
would you mind trying it just one more 
time?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Weeell, fine by me. I'm gonna go all out 
though, so stand back~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: —Ready, set... go!
(WHAM)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...See?! Isn't it totally ridiculous to 
punch full-force and not even rank?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I see......

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well then, would you mind doing just as I 
say for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
First, stop clenching your thumbs inside 
your fists. You're doing that to protect 
your nails, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? What?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Next is the stance. Put the leg opposite 
to your punching arm forward, turn your 
body at an angle—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, wait, wait, like this?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Loosen the knees... raise the heels 
slightly, and tuck in the elbows.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Keep your wrists and arms straight in 
line, and focus on shifting your 
lower-body weight when you swing—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Strike, strike, strike!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh, wha, um—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Strike, strike, strike!
(BLAM!!)
"Congratulations! You win a prize!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh, for real!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I just did what you told me to, though? 
Whoa... my arms are still tingling!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Isn't Acute-san crazy awesome? Like, I've 
got mad respect for her!
choice_data_list: Now that's some serious coaching, huh!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. I actually know just a wee bit 
about boxing, you see."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Back in the day, folks used to call me 
"Right Straight Kyu-chan."
choice_data_list:
Then what if Acute punched them, would it 
be even more...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Back in the day, folks used to call me 
"Right Straight Kyu-chan."
choice_data_list:
Then what if Acute punched them, would it 
be even more...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Right then~. Basically, like I said 
earlier--

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hey, isn't that unfair? I want 
Master to teach me more too!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, then one at a time, dear. It's 
alright, we have lo~ts of time.

Afterward, under Wonder Acute's guidance, 
records were broken one after another.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I wonder...? Then let's give it a try 
once—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: —Shh!
(THUD!!!)

"An error has occurred— Please notify a 
staff member."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Oh dear, did that not go well? Could it 
be that I've gotten rusty, I wonder..."

They ended up learning firsthand the true 
strength of "Right Straight Q-chan"...
